Why do I believe the rise of the Antichrist may not be far away?

Look at Western Europe. In my assessment, Europe as we know it could change beyond recognition within the next five to ten years. That is an assessment of its direction, not a biblical timetable.

The growing influence of political Islam, the failure of the political establishment, the ideological blindness of many young people, and the apathy of those living comfortably are creating conditions for a dramatic backlash.

“Wait a minute, Amir. Are you suggesting that the Antichrist will be a Muslim?”

Not at all!

I believe his rise could come as the answer to a desperate public demanding someone strong enough to restore order, preserve their way of life, and resist political Islam.

A population that sees peace, prosperity, ingenuity, and freedom flourishing does not desperately seek someone to rescue it. But when people believe their security, identity, and future are slipping away, they become vulnerable to anyone promising deliverance.

A quotation commonly attributed to European statesman Paul-Henri Spaak captures that dangerous longing: “Be he god or devil, we will receive him.”

Whether or not that attribution can be authenticated, the danger is real: desperate people can welcome a false savior without examining whose power stands behind him.

Scripture tells us where the Antichrist’s power will come from:

“The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.”
Revelation 13:2, NKJV

“What about believers in Europe, Amir? Isn’t this a message of doom and gloom rather than encouragement?”

Not at all!

First, we must remain busy about our Father’s business. We are called to share the gospel, serve others, and remain faithful:

“And let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart.”
Galatians 6:9, NKJV

Second, our hope is the coming of Messiah Yeshua. I believe Scripture teaches that the church will be gathered to Him before the Antichrist is revealed and the judgments of the Tribulation unfold. Our expectation is a blessed hope:

“Looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.”
Titus 2:13, NKJV

We do not know the day or the hour. But we know whom we are awaiting, and we know what He has called us to do until He comes.

Remain faithful. Keep doing good. Keep proclaiming the truth. Our future is secure in His hands.

Awaiting His Soon Return – Amir

MEN'S HANDS

There’s one part of a man’s body that many women notice—his hands. A gift bestowed by the Creator, hands carry life energy. The hands that embrace you, caress you gently, lift you toward the sky. Strength, passion, tenderness, reliability—so much about a man can be told through his hands.

On a first date, don’t rush into kisses or get too forward. Simply take her hand. A man’s hand has a magnetic effect on a woman. Through touch, she can sense confidence and strength—or, conversely, hesitation, weakness, and coldness.

A man who understands the energy in his hands can captivate a woman, transform her mood, bring her happiness. Like a magician, he skillfully steers the ship of her life. Men's hands are capable of so much—they protect, embrace, hold tight. They can hammer a nail, drive a car, carry bags, or caress you into ecstasy.

His hands can relax you, massage your back, soothe your nerves, warm your soul. And when you sleep wrapped in each other’s arms, you pull his hand closer to your lips, feeling his strength, certainty, and calm.

Men’s hands give you inner harmony, carry you into the bliss of happiness, keep you safe. In them lies all the power and energy. Women entrust their lives to strong hands—because a man’s love truly lives in his palms.

Vladimir Gadzhiev
